$comment: Sapient weapons: a roleplaying persona with a purpose, and a Wisdom save to resist it.

properties.label: Sapient ({goal.label})

changes.name: Conflict of Wills
changes.activationCondition: When the weapon's desires conflict with its wielder's

properties.text:
Sapience. This weapon is a sentient {alignment.label} being with an Intelligence of @int, a Wisdom of @wis and a Charisma of @cha. It has {senses.label}, and it communicates by {communication.label}.

Personality. {personality.label} It speaks in @voice.

Purpose. {goal.label}.

Quirk. {quirk.label}

Conflict. When its wielder acts against its purpose, or passes up a chance to pursue it, the weapon demands its way. The wielder must succeed on a [[/save wis @dc]] saving throw or do as the weapon wishes until the moment passes.
